statements.text: The textarea is described only by its supporting text; an aria-describedby on the host is not forwarded to it.

attributes.description: Maximum number of characters, forwarded to the native textarea.
attributes.name: maxlength

attributes.description: Native form name used during submission.
attributes.name: name

attributes.description: Optional supporting text shown below the field.
attributes.name: supporting-text

events.description: Emitted when the value is committed.
events.name: change

events.description: Emitted when the value changes while typing.
events.name: input

slots.description: Leading inline content such as a note or search affordance.
slots.name: before

examples.html: <violet-text-area disabled label="Harvest notes" name="harvestNotes" placeholder="Unavailable while sync is running" rows="5" supporting-text="Disabled areas should still show their footprint in a dense form."></violet-text-area>

<violet-text-area invalid label="Harvest notes" name="harvestNotes" placeholder="Describe the issue..." required rows="5" supporting-text="Required before submitting the crop review."></violet-text-area>

<violet-text-area label="Planting notes" name="plantingNotes" placeholder="Add observations for this bed..." required rows="4" supporting-text="Keep the most recent field notes with the current plan."></violet-text-area>

summary: Multi-line text input with a built-in label and supporting text; use for free-form text longer than one line.

usage.text: Only required (whitespace-only counts as empty) and invalid affect validity. The maxlength attribute limits typing but a longer value set from script is not reported invalid. A readonly field is never invalid.
The rows attribute sets the initial height and falls back to 4 when it is not a positive number; the user can still resize the field vertically.
There is no error-text attribute and no error message is rendered: invalid only turns the border red and sets aria-invalid. Put the error wording in supporting-text while invalid.
